assumptions.statement: All behavioral coefficients are explicit structural assumptions, not measurements of product superiority.
Token prices and GitHub plan economics are frozen to the public 2026-09-04 snapshot.
Each coupling ID preserves the same latent task, provider load, tool failures, and verifier shocks across scenarios.
Compared scenarios face the same external verifier at each design point.
Uncached input, cache reads, cache writes, and output form separate token ledgers.
Provider-value, marginal-cash, allocated-cash, human-time, SLA, and failure costs remain distinct until economic loss is calculated.
Vendor ecosystem, governance, privacy, negotiation, and user-learning effects are outside the model boundary.

hypotheses.claim: Resource-aware fixed-Terra usage reduces normalized cost per verified work by at least 10 percent.
hypotheses.estimand: Paired mean difference in normalized_cost_per_verified_work (resource-aware-frontier minus resource-unaware-frontier).
hypotheses.decisionRule: Support under the model only when every declared 95% paired interval clears the practical threshold; challenge when an interval lies wholly on the failing side; otherwise report inconclusive.
hypotheses.falsificationRule: Cold cache, tool failure, and long context test whether control overhead or reduced capability reverses the reduction.

hypotheses.claim: Resource-aware fixed-Terra usage is quality-noninferior within 0.02 to resource-unaware fixed-Sol usage.
hypotheses.estimand: Paired mean difference in external_quality_score (resource-aware-frontier minus resource-unaware-frontier).
hypotheses.decisionRule: Support under the model only when every declared 95% paired interval clears the practical threshold; challenge when an interval lies wholly on the failing side; otherwise report inconclusive.
hypotheses.falsificationRule: High-complexity and strict-verification points test whether Terra stays inside the quality margin.

hypotheses.claim: Resource-aware fixed-Terra usage reduces normalized wall time by at least 10 percent.
hypotheses.estimand: Paired mean difference in normalized_wall_time (resource-aware-frontier minus resource-unaware-frontier).
hypotheses.decisionRule: Support under the model only when every declared 95% paired interval clears the practical threshold; challenge when an interval lies wholly on the failing side; otherwise report inconclusive.
hypotheses.falsificationRule: Highly parallel tool work tests whether the broad eager policy is faster despite overhead.

hypotheses.claim: Phase-aware routing reduces normalized cost per verified work by at least 5 percent relative to resource-aware fixed Terra.
hypotheses.estimand: Paired mean difference in normalized_cost_per_verified_work (resource-aware-phase-routing minus resource-aware-frontier).
hypotheses.decisionRule: Support under the model only when every declared 95% paired interval clears the practical threshold; challenge when an interval lies wholly on the failing side; otherwise report inconclusive.
hypotheses.falsificationRule: Verification-heavy long-context work tests whether Sol verification erases Luna planning savings.

hypotheses.claim: Phase-aware routing is quality-noninferior within 0.01 relative to resource-aware fixed Terra.
hypotheses.estimand: Paired mean difference in external_quality_score (resource-aware-phase-routing minus resource-aware-frontier).
hypotheses.decisionRule: Support under the model only when every declared 95% paired interval clears the practical threshold; challenge when an interval lies wholly on the failing side; otherwise report inconclusive.
hypotheses.falsificationRule: Exploration-heavy tasks test whether cheaper planning loses information that later verification cannot recover.
